title: sepOS Service Topology & IPC Endpoint Specification

services.name: KeyStoreServer
services.role: AppleKeyStore (AKS) master manager, Class A through D key derivation, file system media key unwrapping, and passcode iteration scrypt engine.

services.name: BiometricServer
services.role: Pearl Face ID biometric authentication pipeline, NIR camera frame anti-spoofing verification, neural embedding scoring, and signed biometric match token issuance.

services.name: ApplePayServer
services.role: Embedded Secure Element (eSE) Stockholm manager, EMV dynamic cryptogram generation, payment applet authorization, and transaction signature verification.

services.name: CredentialServer
services.role: FIDO2 / WebAuthn passkey management, hardware Attestation Identity Key (AIK) creation, hardware-bound cert issuance, and device identity assertions.

services.name: AntiReplayServer
services.role: Anti-Replay Token (ART) lifecycle validation, External Anti-Replay Token (xART / Gigalocker) persistent synchronization, and monotonic OTP counter enforcement.

services.name: EntropyServer
services.role: Silicon True Random Number Generator collector, NIST SP 800-90B continuous health monitor, AES-256 CTR_DRBG conditioner, and host kernel reseed provider.

services.name: TightbeamSecureBridge
services.role: ExclaveOS inter-enclave communication bridge (tbms), handling direct RPC requests from Conclaves over DART-SEP Stream ID 2 and shared Datacubes.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_CONTROL
ipc_endpoints.description: Kernel boot handshake, clock synchronization, sleep/wake notifications, and panic telemetry extraction.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_KEYSTORE
ipc_endpoints.description: AppleKeyStore (AKS) class protection operations, keybag unwrapping, and passcode iteration.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_BIOMETRIC
ipc_endpoints.description: Pearl Face ID sensor configuration, biometric template match requests, and signed authorization tokens.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_STORAGE
ipc_endpoints.description: Persistent Anti-Replay Tokens (ART/xART), anti-rollback counter validation, and secure storage.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_SECURE_ELEMENT
ipc_endpoints.description: Stockholm embedded Secure Element (eSE) APDU passthrough, payment tokens, and CarKey credentials.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_CREDENTIAL
ipc_endpoints.description: FIDO2 / WebAuthn passkey generation, signing, and hardware device attestation.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_ENTROPY
ipc_endpoints.description: High-entropy true random byte streaming from on-chip TRNG to Darwin XNU kernel pool.

ipc_endpoints.name: SEP_ENDPOINT_EXCLAVE_BRIDGE
ipc_endpoints.description: Direct Tightbeam RPC channel between ExclaveOS Conclaves (sksd) and sepOS.
